description: What changed at a French company since a date ("what changed at this customer since June?"): every official block in one call, namely BODACC notices (insolvency, sales, deregistration, changes, accounts filings with their figures), commercial-court decisions, French and EU public contracts, establishments opened or closed, cessation, licences, dated sanctions listings, trademarks, patents and designs, RGE certifications and the lobbying register. Each change is dated at publication (a court decision: the day Sirenic first collected it), with the event date alongside; verdict nouveautes, rien_de_nouveau (every block read in full and fresh) or lecture_incomplete (a block down, stale or partly read, named); monthly stocks (Sirene, French contracts) make a recent date, after their snapshot, yield lecture_incomplete, never rien_de_nouveau; the 100 most recent, per-type totals before the cut. Hiring, officers and headcount band are outside the engine. Paid via x402 ($0.05 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

depuis.description: List what was published since this day, a past day or today. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD (a real date), or a full ISO 8601 timestamp (offset Z, ±HH:MM, ±HHMM or none, read as UTC): only its UTC day is kept.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_company_updates_since

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: French company: everything new since a date
